info.title: Helo.ai Console API
info.description:
The API behind the Helo.ai console: accounts and workspace, the support desk (inbox, tickets, contacts, broadcasts), WhatsApp numbers, and the relay to Meta’s Business Agent API.

**Signing in.** Every route except the public ones needs the session cookie `sid` from `POST /api/auth/login` (or an emailed link). In this page, “Try it out” uses your current session. Routes also need finished setup and a workspace.

**Roles.** Owner › Admin › Supervisor › Agent. Each route says the lowest role that may call it (from src/app/lib/permissions.ts).

**Errors.** `{title, detail, status}`. Every response has an `x-trace-id` header; owners and admins can look up what a request did with `GET /api/trace/{id}`.

**Same origin only.** No CORS; the console and the API share a host (Vite proxies `/api` in development, Vercel rewrites it in production).

**Who can call:** Anyone; no sign-in.

Meta calls this once when the callback URL is saved. Answers the challenge as plain text when `hub.verify_token` equals WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN.

403.description: Verification failed.

post.description:
**Who can call:** Meta, signed by a listening app.

Every WhatsApp event for the connected accounts: messages, statuses (with per-message pricing), echoes, standby, handovers, marketing preferences, template and number changes, account notices.

The body must carry a valid `X-Hub-Signature-256` from one of the apps in WEBHOOK_APP_SECRETS (401 otherwise). With no secret set, or no database, it answers 503 so Meta keeps the event and retries (up to 7 days).

Each delivery is stored exactly as sent (webhook_inbox, once per body even when Meta retries), processed, then answered 200. A delivery that fails to process is kept and retried automatically; events for a number no workspace has are kept, not dropped.

The business’s own number is listen-only: an event never makes the console send anything.

parameters.name: X-Hub-Signature-256

schema.description: `sha256=<HMAC of the raw body with the app secret>`.

parameters.description: `sha256=<HMAC of the raw body with the app secret>`.

401.description: Not signed by a known app.

503.description: Not set up yet (no app secret) or the database is unavailable: Meta retries later.

get.description:
**Who can call:** Vercel Cron: `Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>`.

Called by Vercel Cron (03:00 UTC, see vercel.json): resumes broadcasts, schedules billing and health checks, runs due jobs, and collects Meta’s metrics, handoffs, connector logs and traces. Any method works. Not on the local server.

**Who can call:** Any signed-in member of the workspace.

Pushes every change in your workspace as it happens: `data: {kind, entity, entityId, data, at, traceId}`. Starts with `retry: 5000`; a `: ping` comment every 25 seconds keeps proxies from closing it. On Vercel it answers 204 (no long-lived connections) and screens poll instead.

**Who can call:** Admin or above (`traces.read`).

Every response carries an `x-trace-id` header; errors show its first 8 characters as “Reference: …”. This returns that request’s events, Meta calls and configuration changes, oldest first (500 of each at most).

schema.description: The full trace id, or its first 8+ characters.

WhatsApp allows free-form replies only within 24 hours of the customer’s last message; outside it this answers 400 “WhatsApp only allows free replies within 24 hours of the customer’s last message. get.description:
**Who can call:** Reads: any member. Writes (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE): Admin or above (`agent.edit`).

Forwards to Meta’s Business Agent API with the workspace’s token and `X-API-Version: 2.0.0` (`1.0.0` for thread control). Timeout 20 s (90 s for agent_test).

`{path}` is the rest of Meta’s path and may contain slashes; the query string passes through. In it, the segments `PHONE_NUMBER_ID`, `WABA_ID` and `BUSINESS_ID` are replaced with the workspace’s own ids, so the browser never needs real ids. Any other 10+ digit id must belong to the workspace.

Meta’s status and body come back unchanged. GET answers are cached briefly (Graph 10 min; agent settings 60 s; insight date ranges 5 min); identical reads already on their way share one Meta call; a Meta 429 on a read is retried once after Retry-After (max 10 s). Writes are never repeated.

Local safety limit per number per rolling hour: 1000 calls per resource, 500 agent_test.

403.description: Not your WhatsApp account (an id that isn’t the workspace’s). / Only owners and admins change the AI agent. / No WhatsApp account connected.

429.description: Local safety limit reached (…). Or Meta’s own 429 (shared across everything using the same app and token).

502.description: Upstream unreachable: Meta didn’t answer in time.

session.name: sid
session.description: Set by POST /api/auth/login. HttpOnly, so the browser sends it for you.

NotLoggedIn.description: Not logged in: no session, or it expired.

Forbidden.description: Not allowed: setup not finished, no workspace, or your role can’t do this (the detail says which).

DatabaseUnavailable.description: The database isn’t available (title: “Database not configured” or “Database unavailable”).

Error.description: Every error from our own routes. Relay routes pass Meta’s body through instead: {title, detail} or Graph’s {error: {message, code, fbtrace_id}}.

setup.description: `account`: email verified, name, password and workspace still to set. `password`: opened a reset link.

joining.description: Invited and still setting up: the workspace they’ll join.

invites.description: Empty unless you can manage members.

joining.description: Invited people who verified their email but haven’t finished setting up. Empty unless you can manage members.

id.description: Stored file id; download with GET /api/inbox/media/{id}.

state.description: `pending`: still being fetched from WhatsApp. `failed`: WhatsApp no longer has it.

body.description: null for a customer message Meta reported (from a conversation turn) whose words only arrive by webhook.

tools.description: Tools the AI agent used for this reply.

turnId.description: Set on agent replies rebuilt from Meta’s conversation turns; the text is then a short preview.

username.description: WhatsApp username, for a customer who hides their number.

owner.description: Who is answering: the AI agent or the team.

windowOpen.description: Inside WhatsApp’s 24-hour window, so free-form replies are allowed.

sample.description: Sample data: stored, never sent to WhatsApp.

viewers.description: Teammates with this chat open in the last 20 seconds.

reminders.description: Your reminders still to come for this chat.

shared.description: Shared with the whole workspace (else only yours).

source.description: What opened it: the AI handed off, a teammate took over, a team reply, or created by hand.

week.description: Keys sun…sat; times HH:MM; null = closed.

sla.description: Per priority (urgent, high, normal, low): minutes of business time.

restrictAgents.description: Agents see only their own chats and tickets, plus unassigned ones.

aiSummary.description: Read-only: the server can write AI summaries (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set).

saved.description: Read-only: false until the workspace saves these settings (the values are then Helo.ai’s defaults).

listenOnly.description: Read-only: the business’s own number, where the console sends nothing on its own (no away message, no feedback question).

Notice.description: A ticket notice, an alert (owners and admins) or one of your reminders.

phone.description: Phone number, or BSUID for a customer who hides their number.

fields.description: Custom field values by field key (see /api/contacts/fields).

phone.description: Required when creating. 8 to 15 digits, country code first.

tags.description: A list, or one comma-separated string.
Contacts with any of these tags.

activeDays.description: Wrote to you in the last N days.

status.description: Meta’s review status: APPROVED, PENDING, REJECTED…

retrying.description: Queued again after a failure WhatsApp asked us to retry (e.g. its daily marketing limit).

preview.description: The message as the first recipient sees it.

sample.description: Sample contacts: stored, never sent to WhatsApp.

gotMarketingToday.description: Already got a marketing message from you in the last 24 hours.

unpriced.description: People whose country has no recent rate, so they aren’t in `total`.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time, or milliseconds since 1970 (older rows).

lastOpenedAt.description: ISO 8601 time, or milliseconds since 1970 (older rows).

onboardedAt.description: ISO 8601 time, or milliseconds since 1970 (older rows).

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 time, or milliseconds since 1970 (older rows).

endedAt.description: ISO 8601 time, or milliseconds since 1970 (older rows).

ts.description: ISO 8601 time, or milliseconds since 1970 (older rows).

at.description: ISO 8601 time, or milliseconds since 1970 (older rows).

resource.description: Which part of the agent, e.g. faq, skills, agent-ui-skills.

state.description: ok, no_billable_account (Meta reports usage once the agent has a payment method), error_<status>, or null before the first check.

agentUsage.description: Meta Business Agent usage this month (business_agent_insights, collected hourly).

messages.description: This month’s messages as WhatsApp priced them in their status webhooks.

display.description: The number as people dial it.

sandbox.description: A Meta test number (sandbox): replies reach only up to 5 verified recipients.

pinStorage.description: The server can store this number’s PIN (TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY is set).

managed.description: The business’s own number: registration, PIN and codes can’t be changed here.

sandbox.description: A Meta test number: it can only message up to 5 verified recipients.

steps.description: Signup steps (exchange, subscribe, register, billing, sync, details) and how each went.

protected.description: The business’s own account: read and agent configuration only; its webhooks, registration, PIN and billing are never changed here.

reason.description: The agent answered with Meta’s fallback, or handed the chat to a person.

count.description: How many times it was asked.
